meaning:
ἐνεδρεύω
(ἐνέδρα), [in LXX chiefly for אָרַב ;]
to lie in wait for: with accusative of person(s), Luk.11:54, Act.23:21.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have…
